causal_confidence.statement: Both packet interpretations say SOLVED, CAUSATIVE and PATHOGENIC for each allele, with OMIM:621506 neurodevelopmental disorder with parkinsonism or other movement abnormalities. The paper reports PD/parkinsonism and a novel EPG5 association with supportive cell/model observations, but supplies no explicit ACMG evidence-code classification validating those PATHOGENIC assertions or this exact OMIM disease identifier. Source-supported onset is retained separately. UNKNOWN_ACTIONABILITY is not evidence of a therapy; no clinical actionability claim is inferred.

limitations: This adjudicates correspondence to the published source, not clinical truth or an independent ACMG classification.
Source causal alternatives include homozygous CACNA1C p.R2020W and compound-heterozygous PLXNB2 p.G842S/p.R1725H in both sisters; segregation alone does not select EPG5 uniquely.

No significant burden association is reported in TableS7 (all12p-values0.31-0.61); complete knockout mice do not model the exact patient variants (PDFp15). These do not independently resolve clinical causality.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All 25 phenotype items, explicit negatives and onset were individually compared with the ARPD-F1 II-1 column. The packet omits motor fluctuations, asymmetric onset, cognitive impairment as a separate row and quantitative MMSE/MoCA/UPDRS/Hoehn-Yahr context. Older sister hearing and PET are NA, not normal; the packet appropriately does not convert them to exclusions. Cerebral atrophy is reported in Table2/Figure2A; Figure2 caption duration8years differs from Table2 duration9years.

The paper reports PD/parkinsonism and a novel EPG5 association with supportive cell/model observations, but supplies no explicit ACMG evidence-code classification validating those PATHOGENIC assertions or this exact OMIM disease identifier. Source-supported onset is retained separately. UNKNOWN_ACTIONABILITY is not evidence of a therapy; no clinical actionability claim is inferred.

limitations: Mainp6/Table1 includes both an in-frame deletion and a frameshift, inconsistent with abstract/p6 summary of3nonsense+7missense variants. Exact family variants are preserved rather than using that aggregate variant-type summary.

MainTable2 and p7 say ARPD-F1II-2 MRI normal, whereas Figure2C p9 explicitly describes mild brain atrophy at age17 after3years. Figure2B shows earlier age14 normal scan. Preserve internal conflict and age context; do not silently accept cerebral-atrophy exclusion at17.

Figure5 reports3independent laboratory experiments and235/230cells, not those numbers of independent patients. Figure4 skin biopsy from3probands and cell/model results do not by themselves establish clinical causality or treatment efficacy.

Complete knockout mouse model explicitly acknowledged at PDFp15 as closer to Vici syndrome and not a faithful model of patient variants. Article establishes proposed association, not independent clinical validation; individual-level raw datasets available on request are not held or solicited.

Supplementary figures contain embedded labels but no separate prose legends in the supplied15files. FigureS3 has some low-resolution machine metadata; all clinical panels and legible report bodies inspected with exact crops, without inferring unreadable acquisition microtext or independently diagnosing images. FigureS8 full blots visually inspected, not a forensic integrity or quantitative reanalysis.
